name: QACUSD
description: QACUSD is the on-chain mirror of client balances held on the Quantum Algorithmic Capital ledger. Every token on Base equals one unit a verified client moved out of the platform; tokens sent back to the bridge address are credited again. Minting is capped at 100,000,000 and limited per UTC day; all contract roles sit on a 2-of-3 hardware-wallet Safe. Not a stablecoin: the price is set only by the platform's own market.
